svg.text: SettleMate AI — System Architecture & Financial Control Plane
Track 04: AI Finance Controller · Deterministic Authority with AI-Assisted Exception Investigation
AI investigates · Critics challenge · Deterministic systems decide

g.text: · High Conf + Low Exp → Fast Path
1. Arithmetic Lens: Checks fee & tax math exactness
2. Timing Lens: Enforces SLA & banking settlement dates
3. Relationship Lens: Validates gateway entity graphs
Objection confirmed → AI refines claim with counter-evidence
AI cannot modify balances, bypass gates, or self-approve.
All outputs pass to mechanical verification gates.
· Operations Center Coordination: Client steps execution in bounded, authoritative slices.
· Dual Database Engine: PostgreSQL (pg.Pool / Neon) + SQLite (better-sqlite3 WAL).
· Resumability & Checkpoints: Stalled job detection; crash-safe recovery from disk.
· Authoritative Cancellation: Cooperative state machine with <1000ms terminal latency.
· Strict Multi-Tenant RLS: Row-level isolation; cross-tenant access hard blocked (404/403).
· Server-Derived Identity: HMAC session tokens; actor and role cannot be forged in payload.
· Separation of Duties: REVIEWER investigates; only ADMIN can approve high-exposure writes.
· Prompt-Injection Quarantining: All bank narrations treated as untrusted text.
· SSRF Protection: Outbound webhook dispatcher blocks loopback, private CIDRs & metadata IP.
96 Automated Test Suites · 24/24 Pipeline Scenarios · 30/30 Milestone 5 Proofs Passed
